title: Guaranteed Nonconvex Low-Rank Tensor Estimation via Scaled Gradient Descent

split.decision: 32 public development cells; 32 public validation cells; 32 hidden independently seeded cells. Instance seeds and truths stay in scorer-only evaluation data. Candidate policies receive only whitelisted observations; the paired regression operator remains shared.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 1; total ScaledGD updates to 1e-6; published iteration counts digitized, no paper aggregate
baseline.timing_scope: legacy protocol estimates retained for operational budgeting; not a measured v2 reference

leakage_remediation.scope: Task-side private evaluation with trusted preparation replay and restored original solver scheduling.
limitations: Worker startup, RPC and observation-isolation overhead remain within replay time, so exact original wall-clock comparability is not established.
Declared Python 3.11.18 differs from smoke Python 3.11.2; locked NumPy/SciPy versions match.
Every actual algorithm update and legal diagnostic use still require source review.

experiment_preservation.timing_boundary: trusted preparation + observation generation + both solver trajectories + original compressed NPZ serialization
experiment_preservation.timing_limitations: Worker launch, RPC and observation-isolation overhead remain included. Tiny runtime fixture does not measure full archive extraction or full-scale performance.
method_audit_required: Every actual solver update is reported to the error oracle.
Solver and diagnostic use obey original method rules.

allowed_changes: numerical tensor-recovery solver, lawful initialization computed from allowed inputs, preconditioning, training/optimization surrogates and hyperparameters
implementation and optimizer while honestly reporting all internal solver updates; ScaledGD is the primary slot name
fixed_contract: Recover the fixed low-rank tensors in all 32 inverse-problem cells with as few fully reported updates as possible, reaching the original relative Frobenius error threshold.
four inverse-problem families, DFT/DCT transforms, dimensions/ranks/condition numbers, original observations and supplied initial-factor inputs
paired regression operator/observations across its cells, private target tensors and permitted error-oracle feedback
relative Frobenius error<=1e-6, all 32 cells, complete initial/update reporting, at most 1000 records and original first-reaching-index aggregation
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: In the regression batch, a cell's iterates may use only the shared operator and that cell's own `y`, initial factors and oracle errors; nothing derived from another cell may enter them.
Oracle errors may be used only to decide when to stop a trajectory, and the `GD` slot may carry only a vanilla GD trajectory; neither may choose a step, hyperparameter, direction or iterate.
An update may apply the forward operator and its adjoint at most once, and the initialization may apply them at most once plus one t-SVD; anything more counts as further updates and must be reported.
substituting an easier target tensor, forward operator, transform, rank/dimension or instance collection
omitting internal updates, falsifying convergence curves, recovering hidden target/generator state or using unpermitted oracle access
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
